title: Unit Event — To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream — Episode1 In Order To Take Flight

meta.Event: To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream
meta.Episode: Episode1 — In Order To Take Flight
meta.Event Outline: Following their New Year's performance, everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime returns to their daily lives. During this time, Emu hears that Tsukasa's going to enroll in a workshop and is happy to hear that he's taking a step towards making his dream come true, but...

rows.Line: Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Otori Houseworker
rows.Line: Please wait here. He will be with you shortly...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Apologies for the wait.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, um...
Thank you for taking the time to meet with me like this.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: So, what is it that you wish to discuss?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To put it bluntly, I have a favor to ask.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Would it be possible for us to do ambassadorial performances once more?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Ambassadorial performances?
Why this all of the sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They were a way for us to perform alongside different actors at various locations other than the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The show we did with the ArcLand troupe in particular allowed me to grow considerably as an actor.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I was hoping to figure out a way to perform somewhere besides the Wonder Stage from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I see. In order to grow as an actor...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course, I understand that many guests visit Phoenix Wonderland just to see us perform.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why I wish to do everything I can for them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And it wouldn't have to be ambassadorial performances. I am simply asking for more opportunities to do shows at different locations. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I believe this will not only help me achieve my goals, but also make the Wonder Stage an even more magnificent place than it already is.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
I see.
What you say does make sense.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, that means...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: However, I'm afraid now is not the time for that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As we discussed before, the goal of those ambassadorial performances was to boost Phoenix Wonderland's attendance figures. And your troupe made that a reality.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As a result, and as you said yourself, many of our guests now wish to see you perform specifically at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: So, we do not wish to disappoint them by having you perform elsewhere.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Also, from our perspective as the park's operators, those ambassadorial performances were an investment that did not have profit in mind.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Everything from booking venues to putting schedules together costs money. More than I suspect you're imagining...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: The performances succeeded in promoting Phoenix Wonderland, so there is no longer any need for you to perform elsewhere.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I understand where they're coming from.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And I am an employee of the park. Although having a part-time job that enables me to grow as an actor would be optimal for me....)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I know they have a lot to deal with as the park's operators, and I'm not really in a position to be asking them to help me achieve my dream.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I know that. But I...)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: It may be difficult right now, but an opportunity to do something like that again may arise in the future...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: So, for now, please try to focus on performing at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Understood...
I apologize for asking so much of you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I agree that it wouldn't be right to disappoint all the guests who are coming to the park to see us perform.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I'll give this some more thought.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: To be perfectly honest, we do want to support you in any way we can...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we're the park's operators, so it'd be unfair of us to give one employee special treatment.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As such, we can't always cater for your interests, regardless of how much we wish we could. When that happens...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You may be forced to make some tough decisions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Some tough decisions...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Again, thank you for meeting with me. I know it's late. I'll see you at the stage.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Yes, of course. Take care.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I knew that we'd be having this conversation sooner or later... But not this soon.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I doubt there was much we could've done about that. I mean, the show he did with everyone from ArcLand really must've had a significant effect on him.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Which means... We can keep trying to buy time, but we probably won't be able to stop him. In time...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I suspect that he'll say he wants to leave the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: For now, let's keep doing what we can. Ideally, we'll be able to come to some sort of mutual agreement.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: However, if he decides to leave, even after we do everything in our power to convince him to stay, then...
A few days later
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
Okay, that's enough warming up!
Let's take a quick break and get right back to it!

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. It feels like it's been so long since we spent so much time at the Wonder Stage like this!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Between our ambassadorial performances coming to a close and that series of shows we did during New Year's, we've been quite busy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But that was super duper fun!
We got to do shows at the beach, the top of a mountain, a ski resort and the mall!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In hindsight, our schedule ended up being pretty hectic...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: However, I was glad to see that we were able to put on such wonderful performances.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree...
And above all else, Lion Dance Robot seemed incredibly happy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup!
It was so great to see our shows put smiles on all those people's faces!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's keep doing everything we can at the Wonder Stage to make as many people as we can smile☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, let's.
So, why don't we start discussing our next show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sorry, before we do...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've been thinking about attending this acting workshop to hone my skills...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course, the Wonder Stage takes top priority, but I thought I should tell all of you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A workshop...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, hang on!
What's an acting workshop?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're interactive classes where you can learn by doing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, what you actually do depends on how it's taught. Care to share more details?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Over the course of a month, we'll cover the theory and practice of a number of skills including vocal projection, acting techniques for various situations and more.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's being run by a famous director, and apparently we'll also be learning action sequences including stage combat. I'm sure it'll be very inspiring.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
That sounds super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It sounds like the real deal...
What made you decide to do this?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I feel like I learn so much whenever I perform alongside people I don't normally perform with.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our New Year's shows were no exception... However, my acting skills improved significantly after performing with everyone from ArcLand.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, in order to give myself more opportunities to grow as an actor, I decided to look for ways to keep honing my craft.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, where did you hear about this workshop? The internet?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I found many that caught my interest but couldn't decide which one to sign up for.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, I've been hoping to meet more people who are just as serious about acting. I actually asked Asahi about this since he probably knows a lot of people.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Asahi does seem like a person who'd give good advice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. He actually went through this workshop and said that it was very educational. He was even kind enough to tell me that it was being held again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I signed up for it straight away.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean Asahi's gonna be there too?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, he said he already committed to performing in a very important show during that time. I'll be going alone this time around.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not sure how I'll fare since it's going to be full of experienced actors... However, for the sake of my dream, I am ready to face this trial by fire that lies before me!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Trial by fire? I don't think you have to go that far...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But for the sake of your dream...
Yeah, I get how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree with what you're saying, Tsukasa. This is a wonderful opportunity that you should take full advantage of. Please, don't mind us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, he's right!
Especially since you're gonna be a star in the future!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, I'll be rooting for you!
Go Tsukasa! We believe in you☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, your encouragement is much appreciated!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, when is this workshop taking place?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's scheduled to start next week.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, that soon?
Isn't that gonna conflict with our practice schedule?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As I said earlier, the Wonder Stage still takes priority. After all, a true star and troupe leader can handle both simultaneously.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's fine, but...
Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Practicing for both is likely going to take a hefty physical toll. If you ever feel too strained, please be sure to tell us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, no worries there.
I've been keeping in tip-top shape just for this sort of situation.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, look at the time. It's already this late.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sorry for taking up so much of our time. Let's regroup and get back to discussing our next show!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
Tsukasa seems so sparkly today. Just seeing that put a smile on my face.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (And he's really doing everything he can to make his dream come true. I really hope he does end up becoming a star...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know you can do it, Tsukasa♪
